rows.answer: **Nike had more employees.** At the end of its FY2025 (May 31, 2025), Nike had approximately **77,800 employees worldwide**, compared with lululemon’s approximately **39,000 employees** at the end of FY2024 (February 2, 2025). [1][2]

Columbia Sportswear had the higher effective tax rate: **25.1%** for fiscal 2024, versus **17.1%** for Nike’s fiscal 2025. [1][2] Columbia’s rate was therefore **8.0 percentage points higher**. [1][2]

Lululemon had the higher 2024 gross margin: **59.2%**, versus **50.2%** for Columbia Sportswear—a difference of **9.0 percentage points**. Lululemon’s fiscal year ended February 2, 2025, while Columbia’s ended December 31, 2024. [1][2]

In fiscal 2025, **Under Armour’s inventories decreased**, while **Deckers’ inventories increased**:

- **Under Armour:** Inventories fell from **$958.495 million on March 31, 2024, to $945.836 million on March 31, 2025**—a decrease of **$12.659 million, or 1.3%**. [1]
- **Deckers:** Inventories rose from **$474.311 million on March 31, 2024, to $495.226 million on March 31, 2025**—an increase of **$20.915 million, or 4.4%**. [2]

In fiscal 2025, **Under Armour’s wholesale revenue decreased 8.1%**, falling from **$3.243 billion in fiscal 2024 to $2.979 billion in fiscal 2025**—a decline of **$264.3 million** (fiscal year ended March 31, 2025). [1]

By contrast, **Deckers’ wholesale revenue increased 17.4%**, rising from **$2.432 billion to $2.856 billion**—an increase of **$423.6 million** over the same fiscal-year period. [2]

**Deckers grew diluted earnings per share faster.** Lululemon’s diluted EPS increased from **$12.20 in FY2023 to $14.64 in FY2024**, a **20.0%** increase. [1] Deckers’ diluted EPS increased **30.2%** in FY2025, to **$6.33** from **$4.86 in FY2024**. [2][3]

In fiscal 2025, footwear accounted for **23.4% of Under Armour’s total net revenue** ($1,206.2 million of $5,164.3 million; fiscal year ended March 31, 2025) [1]. For the **NIKE Brand**, footwear represented **66.0% of revenue** ($29,510 million of $44,714 million; fiscal year ended May 31, 2025) [2].
